name: Enthalpy v0.4.19
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.19

## Added

- Show a selected note, asset, or folder in Finder on macOS or File Explorer
  on Windows from its context menu.

## Changed

- Area scope now includes attached Project files and their matching daily-note
  sections, including paused, completed, and archived Projects. Unrelated
  content stays excluded.
- File deletion uses an in-app confirmation with the affected content and an
  Undo action after deletion.

## Fixed

- Automation deletion and other confirmation actions use in-app dialogs that
  work in the desktop application.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon. Windows Sync enrollment is deferred until its installed-build
  acceptance passes.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
- Linux packages are deferred.
